description: Tool definitions for Corvi's mail-facing MCP server. Not a complete tools/list JSON-RPC response.

tools.name: mail_list_identities
tools.description: Discover only authorized identities and granted operations. Required permission: mail:identities:list. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

tools.name: mail_list
tools.description: List policy-visible mail only, sorted newest first. No upstream counts. Required permission: mail:messages:list. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Case-insensitive literal query over visible subject and text. Hidden mail is never returned. Required permission: mail:messages:search. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

tools.name: mail_get
tools.description: Get a sanitized mail projection; never return raw MIME or hidden mail. Required permission: mail:messages:read. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

tools.name: mail_get_attachment
tools.description: Get approved attachment bytes as base64 with a 2 MiB decoded size cap. Required permission: mail:attachments:read. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

dataBase64.description: Base64 of permitted content; max decoded size 2 MiB

tools.name: mail_send
tools.description: Send text-only mail from an authorized identity. Require explicit user approval unless unattended automation is permitted. Required permission: mail:messages:send. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

tools.name: mail_get_send_status
tools.description: Get the authorized status of one outgoing submission. Required permission: mail:submissions:read. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.
